components.name: Primary Button (dark)

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Panel fill with a strong 1px rule.

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 8px radius, strong rule, signal border and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 240px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #fff; color: #181816; border: 1px solid #cdc9bd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 14px/20px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #99958a; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: #b57a12; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #b57a12; }

components.name: Workspace Tabs
components.description: Text tabs on a ruled bar; the active tab takes a 2px signal underline.
components.html: TodayProjectsAgents
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2dfd6; background: #fff; padding: 0 12px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; margin-bottom: -1px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #6f6c63; font: 500 14px/20px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #181816; } .ds-tab-active { color: #181816; border-bottom-color: #8a5a00; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b57a12; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-section { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2dfd6; border-radius: 8px; width: 480px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-section-head { padding: 12px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2dfd6; } .ds-section-head h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 16px/24px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #181816; } .ds-section-head p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: #6f6c63; } .ds-section ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; } .ds-row:hover { background: #f7f6f2; } .ds-glyph { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 3px; background: #e2dfd6; color: #3f3e38; } .ds-key { width: 80px; font: 400 12px/16px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #6f6c63; } .ds-title { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; color: #181816; } .ds-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #6f6c63; }

components.name: Active Timer Bar
components.description: Status strip above the header: pulsing signal dot, mono elapsed time, Stop.
components.css: .ds-timer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; background: #efede7; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2dfd6; padding: 6px 16px; font: 400 14px/20px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3f3e38; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #8a5a00; animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 50% { opacity: .5; } } .ds-elapsed { font: 600 16px/24px ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #181816; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tkey { color: #57554d; } .ds-stop { margin-left: auto; min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cdc9bd; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #2a2a26; font: 500 12px/16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stop:hover { background: #e2dfd6; }

narrative.overview:
Ossicone is a tool used for hours by one developer and the agents around them, so it behaves like a bench: surfaces are flat, ruled with 1px hairlines, and quiet, and a single warm signal colour marks what is yours, in progress, or primary. Nothing floats. There are no gradients and no resting shadows; depth is a step in tone (page, then panel) plus a rule.

Two themes share one structure. Dark (the default, set by a .dark class on the root) is warm graphite with amber as the signal. Light is warm paper and ink with brass as the signal. Neither is blue, and neither has a decorative second hue; green, red, yellow and orange exist only as status meaning.

The app's historical Tailwind class names were deliberately reinterpreted instead of renamed: blue is the signal scale, gray is warm paper/graphite and inverts in dark, slate is the always-dark warm graphite family, and purple and indigo read as warm neutrals.
keyCharacteristics: One signal colour per theme, used for the active tab, the primary button, the running timer dot, the mark's knobs, focus rings and links.
Hairline-ruled flat panels at 8px radius; lists divided by 1px rules, not cards inside cards.
Geist throughout with tabular figures on the body; monospace only for issue keys and the timer.
Monochrome line icons (lucide, 1.5 stroke) and monochrome issue-type glyphs; only a bug carries red.
Dense and calm: 14px body, 44px touch rows.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: One amber (dark) or brass (light) accent marks what is yours, in progress, or primary. Status hues report state; they never decorate.

rules.name: The Reinterpreted Scale Rule
rules.body: Class names keep their historical meaning in code and take their palette meaning from index.css. A new surface uses blue for the signal, gray for neutrals, and never hard-codes a hex that a scale step already holds.

rules.name: The Opaque Foreground Rule
rules.body: In dark, text and icon colours come from the opaque foreground override layer, not from the translucent tint steps. Tints are for backgrounds only.

rules.name: The Dark Text On Amber Rule
rules.body: Fills in the signal colour carry near-black text in dark.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Keys Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only on issue keys, project key chips and the timer.

rules.name: The Ramp Is Short Rule
rules.body: Five sizes carry the app: 12, 14, 16, 24 (plus 18 and 20 for dialogs). Do not invent display sizes.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: No gradients and no resting shadows. A surface is separated by tone and a 1px rule.

dos: Do express new surfaces with gray neutrals, blue for the one signal, and the existing remaps; both themes must be checked.
Do separate with a 1px rule and a tone step; keep panels at 8px radius.
Do keep monospace to issue keys and the timer, and keep figures tabular.
Do keep icons monochrome line (lucide at 1.5 stroke) and issue-type glyphs neutral, with red for bug only.
Do give any signal-filled control dark text in dark theme and a 44px touch target.
Do theme any new chart through applyChartTheme.
donts: Don't add gradients or resting shadows.
Don't add a second accent hue or use green, red, yellow or orange as decoration.
Don't colour issue types or give each one a coloured square.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
Don't use a pale-blue sidebar-app layout; navigation is the two ruled tab bars.
